records.name: Leutnant Linienrein
records.biography_en: He enforces the line because deciding where it goes would exceed his rank. He guards the corridor's official line with a baton and a blank order card. HyperNorm calls residents compliant or an exception requiring review. A dissonant card has made him move the line so a tired neighbour can get home without crossing it. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Linie wird gehalten. Ihre Lage überschreitet leider seine Befugnisse.

variant_notes.note_en: He enforces the line because deciding where it goes would exceed his rank.

records.name: Berta Blockordnung
records.biography_en: She is proud of protecting the order and occasionally the people standing behind it. Her small shield protects the order and, when nobody is checking, whoever happens to stand behind it. HyperNorm recognises defence as duty or favouritism. A contradictory card has persuaded her that shelter need not wait for a correct category. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Ordnung wird geschützt. Personen dürfen ausnahmsweise davon profitieren.

variant_notes.note_en: She is proud of protecting the order and occasionally the people standing behind it.

records.name: Niko Nachkommando
records.biography_en: He joined for certainty and is surprised how many instructions contradict it. The oversized helmet promised certainty and has mostly delivered echoes of contradictory instructions. Residents are either ready or a concern. An ambiguous card has made him admit uncertainty to a neighbour, who proved unexpectedly relieved. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Der Dienst schafft Klarheit. Einzelne Befehle werden davon ausgenommen.

variant_notes.note_en: He joined for certainty and is surprised how many instructions contradict it.

records.name: Mara Meldepflicht
records.biography_en: She forwards every command with the smallest possible amount of belief. Her communicator forwards commands with the exact minimum of enthusiasm the building's forms permit. HyperNorm files messages as acknowledged or insubordinate. A dissonant card has taught her to relay a neighbour's question without first polishing it into agreement. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Meldung wurde weitergegeben. Eine persönliche Überzeugung war nicht beigefügt.

variant_notes.note_en: She forwards every command with the smallest possible amount of belief.

records.name: Otto Ordnungskern
records.biography_en: He keeps the imperial machinery running by treating doctrine as a loose fitting. The sealed powercell and wrench keep official grandeur from becoming a dark corridor. HyperNorm calls practical adjustments doctrine or tampering depending on the witness. A contradictory card has persuaded him to help a neighbour before requesting an authorisation code. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Maschine funktioniert. Die Doktrin wurde an einer lockeren Stelle nachgezogen.

variant_notes.note_en: He keeps the imperial machinery running by treating doctrine as a loose fitting.

records.name: Fritz Formularschutz
records.biography_en: He guards the paperwork from a galaxy that refuses to stay in its categories. His three-tab ledger protects the building from residents who refuse to remain on the correct page. HyperNorm recognises cases as filed or threatening. An ambiguous card has made him leave one line blank for a neighbour whose story is not finished. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Aktenlage ist sicher. Das Leben wird um entsprechende Rücksicht gebeten.

variant_notes.note_en: He guards the paperwork from a galaxy that refuses to stay in its categories.
